summary: The old fellowship URL now redirects to Founders, Inc.'s fund/about page. Official pages verify a rolling campus/fund application, San Francisco campus access, funding up to $250k, 4-7% equity, and recurring 4-6 week programs, but no current program named exactly "Fellowship" is published.

proposed_event.name: Founders, Inc. Fellowship
proposed_event.description: Rolling Founders, Inc. campus/fund application for emerging-tech founders seeking capital, workspace, office hours, and community.

location.venue: Founders, Inc. campus at Fort Mason

dates.date_range_text: General applications are reviewed on a rolling basis between programs; Founders, Inc. says its programs usually run 4 to 6 weeks and the campus page says it runs four programs per year.

sources.title: About our fund | Founders, Inc.
sources.supports: The fellowship URL redirects to the official fund/about page; it states Founders, Inc. writes up to $250k checks, asks 4-7% equity, focuses on domains including AI/ML, hardware, Web3, Dev/Tools, and consumer, provides campus access, office hours, fundraising support, hardware lab, community, events, and says programs usually run 4 to 6 weeks.

sources.title: Apply to Founders, Inc.
sources.supports: Official application page says this is a general application to the campus and applications are reviewed on a rolling basis between programs.

sources.title: Our Campus | Founders, Inc.
sources.supports: Official campus page identifies the campus at Fort Mason in San Francisco, describes hardware lab, workspaces, community events, office hours/demo days, and says Founders, Inc. runs four programs per year.

sources.title: Off Season II | Founders, Inc.
sources.supports: Official current program page shows Founders, Inc. has a dated six-week San Francisco program from June 24 to August 7, 2026, but applications were open until June 7 and are only accepting late applications as of the page text.

notes: No official page found using the exact current title "Founders, Inc. Fellowship"; the supplied fellowship URL redirects to the broader Founders, Inc. fund/about page.
Because the named fellowship appears to have been folded into the broader rolling campus/fund application, exact application window and cohort dates are null.

Off Season II has specific 2026 dates, but its regular application deadline was June 7, 2026, which is before today; it was used only as evidence of current program cadence, not as the proposed event.
